newsitem.title: TURKEY: TURKISH PAPER CAMPAIGNS TO CLEAN UP SPORT.
newsitem.headline: TURKISH PAPER CAMPAIGNS TO CLEAN UP SPORT.

text.p: A Turkish newspaper launched a campaign on Thursday to clean up the tarnished image of sport in the country.
"We are opening our pages for the last chance to be saved from the cancer of filth which has dirtied sport in Turkey," Milliyet announced.

Echoing the call for a "clean society, clean politics" that has swept Turkey since the emergence of a political scandal linking the state with underworld gangs, the paper raised a new cry for "clean society, clean sport".

The paper called on those "fed up with the filth in sport" to join a signature campaign against "the parasites who suck the blood of sport: hooligans, directors after free trips, lazy and stupid trainers, managers with ulterior motives and money-hungry mediators".
